This mod is an [b]Alternative Textures (AT)[/b] conversion for Stardew Valley 1.6, based on the original work found here: (Original Mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18661?tab=description,https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10500)
While the base textures are from the original mod, I have personally designed and added [b]Leotard outfits[/b] and [b]Chokers[/b] to the completely nude original versions to suit my aesthetic preferences.
